_note: VERIFIED CANON of official UK reporting / consumer-protection routes. Single source of truth for: (1) the accuracy gate's allowed phone numbers (content_gate.py derives ALLOWED_PHONE_DIGITS from the phone/sms fields in official_routes AND the phone field in verified_org_contacts), (2) the gate's reporting-email validation (check_sources), and (3) build.py's on-page 'Report this scam' block. NEVER hardcode an org number or reporting route anywhere else. Verify any change against the official source before committing. Phones are normalised to digits-only by the gate. verified_org_contacts is SEPARATE from official_routes: it holds a company's own published support/fraud line, verified against that company's own site, so a guide can name it without the gate treating it as invented. These are NOT national reporting routes and are never rendered in build.py's 'Report this scam' block. Every entry needs source_url + checked_on and must be re-verified quarterly — commercial numbers change far more often than official ones. Prefer telling readers to use the number on their bill/card/official site; only add an entry when naming the number genuinely helps.

Advice Direct Scotland consumer helpline (Scotland)
official_routes.note: TWO GOV.UK pages print DIFFERENT Advice Direct Scotland numbers, which read as a contradiction until you look at what each serves (operator review, 2026-07-29). Resolved 2026-07-30: both are genuine and belong to the same charity. gov.uk/consumer-advice lists 0808 800 9060 (advice.scot, the general advice line, named there for consumer issues); gov.uk/consumer-protection-rights lists 0808 164 6000, which gov.scot confirms is the separate Scottish-Government-funded consumeradvice.scot service run by Advice Direct Scotland — see the advice-direct-scotland-consumeradvice entry below. THIS entry stays the canon on-page consumer route for Scotland because it is the one GOV.UK's dedicated consumer-advice page names.

official_routes.name: consumeradvice.scot consumer helpline (Advice Direct Scotland, Scotland)
official_routes.note: Advice Direct Scotland's dedicated consumer-advice service, funded by the Scottish Government. Recorded so the number is not treated as invented if a guide cites the GOV.UK consumer-protection-rights page, and so the two numbers can never again look like a canon error. NOT on_page: the sidebar carries one consumer route per nation, and that is advice-direct-scotland. Verified against two GOV.UK pages and gov.scot's launch announcement; advice.scot and consumeradvice.scot could not be fetched directly on 2026-07-30 (TLS chain error from this toolchain), so the service split rests on GOV.UK plus gov.scot rather than the charity's own page. Re-verify at the next quarterly canon check.

verified_org_contacts.name: HMRC phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: GOV.UK: "Forward suspicious text messages to 60599" and "Forward suspicious emails to HMRC's phishing team: phishing@hmrc.gov.uk then delete them." This is HMRC's OWN reporting route, not a national one — 7726 remains the network shortcode for forwarding scam texts generally, and this never appears in the on-page 'Report this scam' block. Quoted from the primary page on 2026-07-31.
